name: Craniofacial and Dental Technology Minor
intro: The Herman Ostrow School of Dentistry, the Viterbi School of Engineering Department of Biomedical Engineering and the Dornsife College of Letters, Arts and Sciences Department of Biological Sciences jointly offer the minor in craniofacial and dental technology. This minor is designed to prepare engineering, pre-dental, pre-medical and biological sciences undergraduates to enter the dental biotechnology industry as we

courses.title: Fundamentals of Craniofacial and Dental Technology
Stem Cells and Biomaterials for Tissue Engineering

groups.sub: Enroll in at least two courses from the following to complete at least 16 units outside your home department; further, at least 16 units must be unique to the minor:

courses.title: Applications of Molecular Biology to Medicine
Development and Regulation of Medical Products
Medical Products: From Idea to Market
